title: Reservoir evidence, entity and topology preflight
purpose: Identify candidate reservoir entities intersecting the 230-Reach domain, distinguish authoritative control edges from spatial suggestions, audit local operation observations, and register literature-derived priors without fitting a reservoir model.
allowed_actions: read static reservoir attributes and geometries
read local storage, water-level, area and discharge registries for coverage only
search pre-existing literature and official rules
write evidence, coverage and unresolved-topology audit products
forbidden_actions: modify the accepted rainfall-runoff or fast-slow parent
treat nearest-Reach matching as an authoritative control edge
duplicate one reservoir state across multiple reservoir-named reaches
convert water level linearly to storage without an elevation-storage relation
use 2019-2022 operational outcomes to tune priors for the formal temporal test

time_boundary.state_spinup: 2006-2009, inherited from the canonical is_spinup_period flag; forcing only and excluded from scored likelihoods
time_boundary.development: 2010-2018 when formal fitting is later authorized

success: A reproducible candidate inventory, explicit evidence grades, local data coverage, and a list of unresolved entity/control-edge decisions; success does not authorize formal fitting.
